_note: The new regime's set-off not allowed — the basis of DIS-NEW-TAX-REGIME-NO-SETOFF (D-217; rulebook SETOFF-NEW-001, -002). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.202(2)(b) (pp.227–228): total income computed "without set off of— … (ii) any loss under the head "Income from house property" with any other head of income"; s.202(3): "The loss and depreciation referred to in sub-section (2)(b) shall be deemed to have been given full effect to and no further deduction for such loss or depreciation shall be allowed for any subsequent year." TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.115BAC(2)(ii)(b) and (3), inserted by the Finance Act, 2020 s.53 (egazette 2020/218938 pp.33–34) and not amended since. s.202(2)(b)(i) / s.115BAC(2)(ii)(a), brought-forward loss, is W-081b's.
